*   `?g A3`: Main Concept (green `?`) is A3 (Work / Occupation).
    *   `+ C4`: Cube on C4 (Defense / Protection / Wall).
    *   `+ A11`: Cube on A11 (Seacraft / Naval / Swimming).
    *   `+ D10`: Cube on D10 (Medical / Medicine / Health).

    *   The main concept is an "Occupation/Job".
    *   Sub-concepts/Details:
        *   Defense/Protection/Wall (C4).
        *   Seacraft/Naval/Swimming (A11).
        *   Medical/Medicine/Health (D10).

    *   *Job + Protection + Naval:* Navy soldier, Coast Guard, Sailor.
    *   *Job + Medical + Naval:* Navy doctor, Ship's surgeon, Marine medic.
    *   *Job + Protection + Medical:* Doctor (too broad), Nurse (doesn't fit Naval well), Coast Guard medic.
    *   *Job + Protection + Naval + Medical:* Coast Guard medic? Ship's doctor? Navy medic?
